words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer adds a technical (RFP) round to the event.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals draft.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “RFP duration exceeds RFQ end time. Please adjust.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals draft.
